mining.collapse_empty:
💥 **CATASTROPHE!** The tunnel collapses behind you!
You barely escape with your life.
mining.desc:
You enter the cave...
The air is cool and damp. How deep will you go?
mining.empty_msg:
😐 You exit the mine empty-handed.
📈 **Miner XP:** +{xp}
mining.no_session: You're not currently in the mine — your last expedition has already been secured.
mining.error: ❌ Something went wrong during the expedition. Please try again.
mining.ev_camp_desc: You find an old campfire, still warm. Someone was here recently.
mining.ev_camp_o2d: Catch your breath and restore focus.
mining.ev_camp_r1: You rummage through the camp and find spare supplies!
mining.ev_camp_r2: You sit by the warm ashes and feel your nerves settle.
mining.ev_camp_r3: You press on. The camp is soon swallowed by darkness.
mining.ev_camp_rare_desc: A well-stocked prospector camp! Whoever was here knew what they were doing.
mining.ev_camp_rare_o1d: They won't miss a few things.
mining.ev_camp_rare_o2d: A proper rest will do wonders.
mining.ev_camp_rare_r1: You find gold nuggets and copper ore among their supplies! A great haul.
mining.ev_camp_rare_r2: You rest by the fire and feel completely rejuvenated. The mountain holds no fear for you now.
mining.ev_cart_desc: You find an old mining cart, half-buried in rubble. It might contain supplies.
mining.ev_cart_o1d: Rummage through the cart for anything useful.
mining.ev_cart_r1: You dig through the rubble and find a stash of coal!
mining.ev_cart_r2: You leave the cart behind. Probably wise.
mining.ev_cart_rare_desc: A miner's cart packed with tools and ore! Someone must have fled in a hurry.
mining.ev_cart_rare_o2d: The tools are heavy but sturdy. Better protection.
mining.ev_cart_rare_r1: You pocket a handful of iron ore and a gold nugget!
mining.ev_cart_rare_r2: You salvage a pickaxe head and some straps. The mountain feels less threatening.
mining.ev_chasm_desc: A deep rift splits the tunnel floor. On the other side, you can see rich mineral veins.
mining.ev_chasm_leg_desc: The chasm walls are carved with Kethari runes. An ancient stone bridge spans the gap.
mining.ev_chasm_leg_r1: The bridge holds! You cross safely and find tribute left by the Kethari.
mining.ev_chasm_leg_r2: You climb into the chasm and find a primordial geode! The climb back is treacherous.
mining.ev_chasm_o2d: Jump! It's risky but saves time.
mining.ev_chasm_r1: You inch across the ledge, heart pounding. Safe on the other side.
mining.ev_chasm_r2: You leap! Your boots catch the edge. You made it — barely.
mining.ev_collapse_desc: The ceiling above you groans and cracks. Dust rains down over the tunnel.
mining.ev_collapse_leg_desc: The mountain roars! The floor splits open revealing a hidden Kethari vault below!
mining.ev_collapse_leg_o1d: Quick! Take the treasure and stabilize the tunnel.
mining.ev_collapse_leg_o2d: The vault opens into a deeper passage!
mining.ev_collapse_leg_r1: You grab ancient alloy and shore up the tunnel. The Kethari vault closes behind you forever.
mining.ev_collapse_leg_r2: You descend into the vault's depths, finding a Kethari crystal. The passage seals behind you — you're committed now.
mining.ev_collapse_o2d: Prop the ceiling with timber. Less risk ahead.
mining.ev_collapse_r1: You dart through as a slab crashes behind you.
mining.ev_collapse_r2: You brace the ceiling with fallen timbers. The path ahead feels safer.
mining.ev_collapse_rare_desc: The entire tunnel shudders. Rocks fall from above. You need to act fast!
mining.ev_collapse_rare_o2d: Wait for the collapse to settle.
mining.ev_collapse_rare_r1: You dodge the falling rocks and find a vein of iron ore exposed by the collapse!
mining.ev_collapse_rare_r2: You huddle in a crevice. The collapse passes. You emerge shaken but safe.
mining.ev_crystal_desc: A massive purple crystal pulses in the center of the chamber. The air hums around it.
mining.ev_crystal_leg_desc: The crystal speaks! Images of the Kethari civilization flood your mind. It offers you a choice.
mining.ev_crystal_leg_o1d: The crystal will shield you for the rest of your journey.
mining.ev_crystal_leg_o2d: The crystal offers you its most precious gift.
mining.ev_crystal_leg_r1: The crystal's warmth envelops you. You feel its ancient power protecting you from the mountain.
mining.ev_crystal_leg_r2: The crystal gifts you a Resonance Core, Kethari crystals and ancient alloy. You bow in gratitude.
mining.ev_crystal_o1d: Feel its warmth. It seems friendly.
mining.ev_crystal_o2d: Some things are better left undisturbed.
mining.ev_crystal_r1: Warmth spreads through your arm. The crystal accepts you. The mountain feels less hostile.
mining.ev_crystal_r2: You step away. The pulsing continues, indifferent.
mining.ev_crystal_rare_desc: The crystal seems to breathe. A voice echoes in your mind — ancient and patient.
mining.ev_crystal_rare_o1d: The voice permits you to take a piece.
mining.ev_crystal_rare_r1: You carefully chip off a shard of Kethari crystal. It pulses warmly in your hand.
mining.ev_crystal_rare_r2: A wave of energy washes over you. The ancient alloy in your bag vibrates in harmony.
mining.ev_fungus_desc: Bioluminescent fungi line the walls, casting an eerie blue glow across the cavern.
mining.ev_fungus_o1d: Gather the glowing spores. They might be useful.
mining.ev_fungus_r1: The spores cling to your clothes. The air feels calmer around you.
mining.ev_fungus_r2: You carefully step around the fungi. They pulse in the dark behind you.
mining.ev_gem_desc: You break through into a cavern glittering with precious stones!
mining.ev_gem_o1d: Take what you can carry and leave immediately.
mining.ev_gem_o2d: Mine deeper. More gems, more risk.
mining.ev_gem_r1: You fill your bag with treasures and hurry out before the ceiling collapses!
mining.ev_gem_r2: You greedily chip away at the walls. The gems are incredible but the mountain groans in protest.
mining.ev_gem_rare_desc: This is no ordinary chamber. The walls drip with emeralds and diamonds. A once-in-a-lifetime find!
mining.ev_gem_rare_o1d: Fill your bag to bursting. Then leave.
mining.ev_gem_rare_o2d: Take what you can safely. Better some than nothing.
mining.ev_gem_rare_r1: Your bag bulges with treasure! You barely escape as the chamber collapses behind you.
mining.ev_gem_rare_r2: You chip away carefully, taking high-quality gems. The chamber holds steady.
mining.ev_glow_desc: You spot a faint, pulsating glow behind a cracked rock face.
mining.ev_glow_leg_desc: At the heart of the glow floats a crystalline sphere — a Kethari Luminous Core. It radiates pure energy.
mining.ev_glow_leg_o1d: The core is a legendary artifact. Take it.
mining.ev_glow_leg_o2d: Let the core's energy flow through you.
mining.ev_glow_leg_r1: You claim the core. Kethari crystals and ancient alloy orbit around it as if alive.
mining.ev_glow_leg_r2: The core merges with your being. A Resonance Core materializes in your hand. You are forever changed.
mining.ev_glow_o1d: Chip away at the rock to see what's there.
mining.ev_glow_r1: The glow vanishes as you approach. Just a trick of the light. The tunnel feels unstable.
mining.ev_glow_r1g: You uncover a cluster of radiant crystals! What a find!
mining.ev_glow_r2: You ignore the strange light. Some mysteries are best left alone.
mining.ev_glow_rare_desc: The glow intensifies as you approach. A cluster of radiant crystals hums with potential.
mining.ev_glow_rare_o1d: Take a single crystal. It feels powerful.
mining.ev_glow_rare_o2d: Stand in the radiance. Let it wash over you.
mining.ev_glow_rare_r1: You carefully extract a Kethari crystal. It pulses in rhythm with your heartbeat.
mining.ev_glow_rare_r2: The light flows into you. Your senses sharpen. The mountain seems less dangerous.
mining.ev_guardian_rare_desc: A massive stone golem sits motionless in the center of the chamber. Kethari symbols glow on its chest.
mining.ev_guardian_rare_o2d: Bow to the guardian's eternal watch.
mining.ev_guardian_rare_r1: The guardian's eyes glow. It recognizes your spirit as worthy. Ancient treasure falls at your feet.
mining.ev_guardian_rare_r2: The guardian nods and returns to stone. Its protective aura wraps around you like armor.
mining.ev_lantern_desc: You find an intact miner's lantern. The wick still has oil.
mining.ev_lantern_leg_desc: This is no ordinary lantern. It burns with an eternal blue flame, ancient Kethari fire.
mining.ev_lantern_leg_o1d: Take the lantern. Its fire will protect you.
mining.ev_lantern_leg_r1: The eternal flame accepts you. You feel its warmth deep in your chest. The dark holds no fear.
mining.ev_lantern_leg_r2: The lantern burns with ancient crystals inside. Priceless Kethari artifacts!
mining.ev_lantern_o1d: Warm light reveals the path. Reduced risk.
mining.ev_lantern_r1: You light the lantern. The warm glow makes the dark feel less threatening.
mining.ev_lantern_r2: You pocket the lantern. It might be worth something.
mining.ev_lantern_r3: You leave the lantern where it hangs. It flickers faintly as you walk away.
mining.ev_river_desc: A rushing underground river blocks your path. The current is strong but the water is clear.
mining.ev_river_o1d: Carefully cross through the shallow current.
mining.ev_river_o2d: Dive in and let the current carry you. Risky but faster.
mining.ev_river_r1: You wade across carefully. The cold water is refreshing but slows you down.
mining.ev_river_r2: You swim with the current and emerge further down. Disoriented but deeper.
mining.ev_river_rare_desc: The river plunges into a misty waterfall. Rainbows dance in the spray.
mining.ev_river_rare_o2d: There might be something hidden behind the water.
mining.ev_river_rare_r1: The mist settles your nerves. You feel ready to push deeper.
mining.ev_river_rare_r2: Behind the waterfall you find a crevice filled with gold and emeralds!
mining.ev_shrine_desc: You discover a small shrine with ancient Kethari symbols. It hums with energy.
mining.ev_shrine_leg_desc: The shrine blazes with golden light. The presence of the Kethari is overwhelming. It speaks without words.
mining.ev_shrine_leg_o1d: Receive the shrine's protection and gifts.
mining.ev_shrine_leg_o2d: Ask the Kethari for ancient knowledge.
mining.ev_shrine_leg_o3d: The shrine is heaped with offerings.
mining.ev_shrine_leg_r1: The shrine blesses you! A Resonance Core and Kethari crystals materialize. The mountain feels like an ally.
mining.ev_shrine_leg_r2: Knowledge floods your mind — the Kethari Resonance Engine. An Ancient Core Shard appears in your hand.
mining.ev_shrine_leg_r3: The shrine offers you a Primordial Geode. Your bag feels lighter as the mountain's weight lifts from your shoulders.
mining.ev_shrine_o1d: Sacrifice an item to gain the mountain's favor.
mining.ev_shrine_o2d: Reach out and touch the humming surface.
mining.ev_shrine_o3d: This place is sacred. Leave it be.
mining.ev_shrine_r1: You place an offering on the shrine. The hum grows warmer. You feel protected.
mining.ev_shrine_r2a: A warm energy surges through you. The mountain trembles in your favor.
mining.ev_shrine_r2b: A sharp jolt! The shrine rejects you. The tunnel feels hostile.
mining.ev_shrine_r2c: You feel a flicker of ancient knowledge. The Kethari whispers in your mind...
mining.ev_shrine_r2d: You touch the shrine. Nothing happens. Disappointing.
mining.ev_shrine_r3: You bow your head and leave the shrine undisturbed. A wise choice.
mining.ev_void_desc: An unnatural darkness pools in the corner of the tunnel. A whisper escapes from within.
mining.ev_void_r1: You shut out the whisper and press on. The darkness recedes.
mining.ev_void_r2: The whisper crawls into your mind. You feel unsettled and on edge.
mining.ev_void_rare_desc: The whisper becomes a voice — ancient, tired, speaking in forgotten tongues. But you understand.
mining.ev_void_rare_o1d: This knowledge is not meant for you.
mining.ev_void_rare_o2d: Listen to what the Kethari have to say.
mining.ev_void_rare_r1: You refuse the voice. It fades with a sigh.
mining.ev_void_rare_r2: The voice shares a fragment of Kethari history. You feel wiser for it.
mining.event_ancient_forge:
🔥 **You discover an ancient forge, still warm after ages.** A glowing ingot rests on the anvil.
Gained: **{items}**
mining.event_ghost_miner:
👻 **A translucent figure in old mining gear appears.** They tip their hat and point deeper.
*Ghostly Veil active: -10% risk for 3 digs!*
mining.event_hidden_chamber:
🌌 **The ground gives way!** You tumble into a hidden chamber glittering with crystals!
You gain extra loot: **{items}**
mining.event_whispering_runes:
𓃠 **The wall pulses with glowing runes.** As you touch them, knowledge floods your mind.
Loot bonus: **{items}**
mining.flavor_tier1: Warm torchlight dances on familiar rock. The walls are smooth, well-trodden.
mining.flavor_tier2: The air grows cool. Faint scratches mark the walls , not your own.
mining.flavor_tier3: The tunnel bends strangely, as if carved by hands much older...
mining.flavor_tier4: Ancient symbols flicker in the corner of your eye. The walls seem to breathe.
mining.flavor_tier5: An unnatural silence. Even your pickaxe sounds muffled here.
mining.flavor_tier6: The rock pulses with a warm, amber glow. A deep hum resonates through the floor.
mining.flavor_tier7: You are not alone. Something ancient watches from the dark.
mining.limit_reached: ⛏️ You've mined enough today! Come back tomorrow.
mining.lore_discovery:
📜 **Lore Fragment Discovered!**
*{title}*
Use `/lore` to read the full story.
mining.lore_engine: Deep in the mountain, the Kethari built the **Resonance Engine** , a device that could weave stone like cloth. A low hum escapes from the sealed chamber.
mining.lore_fracture: The glyphs describe **The Great Fracture** , a cataclysm that shattered the Kethari civilization. *"The mountain wept stone tears for seven cycles."*
mining.lore_kethari: The carvings on the wall tell of the **Kethari**, a people who lived within the mountain. *"They sang to the stone, and the stone sang back."*
mining.lore_king: At the deepest cavern lies the **Sleeping King**, the last Kethari monarch, entombed in crystal. The runes warn: *"Disturb not his slumber, lest the mountain wake."*
mining.title: Mining Expedition
mining.tool_broke: 💥 **Your {tool} shattered!** You fall back to the free Iron Pickaxe.
mining.tool_desc: Select your mining equipment for this expedition.
mining.tool_desc_diamond: +2 loot tiers, -10% collapse risk. Breaks after 50 digs.
mining.tool_desc_steel: +1 loot tier, -5% collapse risk. Breaks after 25 digs.
mining.ev_magnet_hoard_desc: The pickaxe clinks against something that is not stone. A buried metal hoard, packed into the rock by an old collapse. You could pull it out with a magnet...
mining.ev_magnet_hoard_o1d: Consume a Rusty Magnet to wrench scrap from the ground.
mining.ev_magnet_hoard_o2d: Consume a Magnet to pull precious ore from the hoard.
mining.ev_magnet_hoard_o3d: Consume an Electric Magnet to tear the richest metal from the rock.
mining.ev_magnet_hoard_o4d: Some things are better left buried.
mining.ev_magnet_hoard_r1: The rusty magnet groans, then yanks scrap ore out of the rock.
mining.ev_magnet_hoard_r2: The magnet sweeps the ground clean — precious ore clings to it in clusters!
mining.ev_magnet_hoard_r3: The electric magnet shrieks with power and rips a rich vein from the stone!
mining.ev_magnet_hoard_r4: You walk on. The hoard stays where it fell.
mining.event_no_magnet: You need that magnet in your inventory to do this!
mining.charter_desc: Before you descend, pick a charter — a personal challenge for this expedition. Complete it before you leave to earn bonus credits and XP.
mining.contract_dig_count_desc: Dig **{target}** times without fleeing — Reward: **{credits}c** + {xp} XP
mining.gamble_win: 🎰 **Double or Nothing — YOU WIN!** Your bag doubled: {bag}
mining.gamble_lose: 🎰 **Double or Nothing — you lose.** Your bag is empty.
mining.ev_spider_desc: The walls crawl with pale cave spiders. Their silk hides glinting ore.
mining.ev_spider_o1d: Torch the silk. Safer but wasteful.
mining.ev_spider_r1: The silk burns away. You slip past the nest unharmed.
mining.ev_spider_r2: You shove through the silk — something bites, and your bag feels lighter.
mining.ev_ore_spring_desc: A warm mineral spring bubbles from the rock, crusted with ore.
mining.ev_ore_spring_o1d: Chip the mineral crust for ore.
mining.ev_ore_spring_r1: You harvest copper and silver from the crust!
mining.ev_ore_spring_r2: The spring revitalizes you. The mountain feels less hostile.
mining.ev_dugout_desc: A tiny dugout shelter, left by a previous miner. Tools and scraps remain.
mining.ev_dugout_o1d: Take ore and patch your tool.
mining.ev_dugout_r1: You patch your tool and pocket some ore!
mining.ev_dugout_r2: You catch your breath. The tunnel ahead seems less threatening.
mining.ev_dynamite_desc: A crate of old dynamite, sweating nitroglycerin. Still dangerous.
mining.ev_dynamite_o2d: Use it to open a rich seam!
mining.ev_dynamite_r1: You carefully defuse the dynamite and find ore nearby.
mining.ev_dynamite_r2: KABOOM! The blast opens a glittering vein — but the tunnel shudders.
mining.ev_goblin_desc: A grinning goblin blocks the tunnel with a sack. "Take a gamble on the sack! Could be treasure, could be rocks!"
mining.ev_goblin_o1d: Take the goblin's sack. Might be treasure, might be rocks.
mining.ev_goblin_r1_win: Jackpot! Gold and emerald spill out!
mining.ev_goblin_r1_lose: Rocks. Just rocks. The goblin cackles and vanishes.
mining.ev_goblin_r2: You shove the goblin aside. He yelps and scuttles away.
mining.ev_geode_desc: The wall is studded with geodes, humming faintly.
mining.ev_geode_o1d: Break a geode for its treasure.
mining.ev_geode_r1: You crack a geode — emerald and platinum gleam inside!
mining.ev_geode_r2: You pry out the largest geode. A rough diamond winks at you as the wall groans.
mining.ev_fossil_desc: An ancient fossil is embedded in the wall, perfectly preserved. A collector would pay well.
mining.ev_fossil_o1d: Take the fossil for its ore.
mining.ev_fossil_r1: You pry the fossil loose — gold and platinum spill from the surrounding rock!
mining.ev_fossil_r2: You study the fossil and find ancient alloy in the surrounding rock. The past speaks to you.
mining.ev_pump_desc: A Kethari pump still hums, pushing amber fluid through cracked pipes. Kethari runes glow on its side.
mining.ev_pump_o1d: Siphon its power to shield yourself.
mining.ev_pump_r1: You drain the pump. Its hum fades as warmth spreads through you.
mining.ev_pump_r2: You tear the pump apart — kethari crystal and ancient alloy clatter out as the pipes burst.
mining.ev_mushroom_desc: Giant mushrooms tower overhead, their caps whispering. "Pick us," they giggle.
mining.ev_mushroom_r1: The mushrooms share a joke and a gem. You leave smiling.
mining.ev_mushroom_r2: You harvest the caps — nuggets spill out, but a spore cloud steals something from your bag.
mining.ev_gas_desc: A greenish gas hisses from a crack. Your eyes water.
mining.ev_gas_o1d: Cover your mouth and fan it away.
mining.ev_gas_r1: You vent the gas carefully. The air clears.
mining.ev_gas_r2: You dash through, coughing. The gas clings to your clothes.
mining.ev_dice_desc: A ghostly miner sits on a crate, rolling bone dice. "Care for a game, stranger? Winner takes treasure."
mining.ev_dice_o1d: Challenge the ghost to a dice game.
mining.ev_dice_r1: The ghost grins and slides the dice...
mining.ev_dice_r1_win: You win! The ghost laughs and tosses you 500c!
mining.ev_dice_r1_lose: Snake eyes. The ghost cackles as your coins vanish.
mining.ev_dice_r2: You decline. The ghost shrugs and fades away.
mining.ev_anvil_desc: A pristine Kethari anvil stands in the chamber, still warm. A hammer rests beside it.
mining.ev_anvil_o1d: Hammer your tool back to shape (+15 durability).
mining.ev_anvil_r1: You hammer your tool — sparks fly, and it feels good as new!
mining.ev_anvil_r2: You take the alloy stock. The anvil hums approvingly.
mining.ev_vault_desc: A Kethari vault door is sealed with three spinning locks. Treasure glints inside.
mining.ev_vault_o1d: Try to pick the three spinning locks. Risky but pays big.
mining.ev_vault_r1_win: Click! The vault opens — a Resonance Core gleams inside, plus your winnings!
mining.ev_vault_r1_lose: The locks jam and spark. Tools broken, coins lost.
mining.ev_vault_r2: You batter the door. Crystals spill out as the mountain groans.
mining.ev_vault_r3: You leave the vault sealed. Some doors stay closed for a reason.
mining.ev_rift_desc: Reality tears open — a swirling rift shows starlight beyond the rock. The Kethari warnings echo.
mining.ev_rift_o1d: Step into the rift. Treasure awaits.
mining.ev_rift_o2d: Close it and learn its secret.
mining.ev_rift_r1: You plunge through — exotic matter burns your hands but fills your bag with legend.
mining.ev_rift_r2: You slam the rift shut. Ancient knowledge floods you as the King stirs in his sleep.
